units.source_text: 第二天照往日习例，起身很迟。

en.t: The next day, as usual, he rose very late.

units.source_text: 源氏写一信送与三公主。

en.t: Genji wrote a letter and sent it to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 三公主年纪还小，不会计较，但源氏写信也仍讲究笔墨。

en.t: The Third Princess was still young and would not notice such things, but Genji still took care over the brush and ink when writing to her.

units.source_text: 他写在一张白纸上，诗曰：

en.t: He wrote on a sheet of white paper, and the poem said:
